title: Literally STUCK in a Long Line in Mall World.

meta.author_theory: Author frames the experience as possibly astral projection vs dream; mentions setting an intention to go to the mall described by the subreddit.

position.relative_to: other areas around and outside it in different dimensions (could not see past grocery store limits)

qualities.raw_description: "brightly lit vast grocery store that seemed to go on for ages"; "could tell there were other areas around and outside it in different dimensions but I couldn't see past the super vast grocery store"; "limits versus walls"

boundaries.description: Perceived boundary as "limits versus walls" of the vast grocery store; dreamer could sense "other areas around and outside it in different dimensions" but "couldn't see past" the grocery store.

interactions.description: On becoming aware/conscious, dreamer "could not move"; asked for "clarity now!" and then could see. Dreamer was in a very long, curved line in the grocery store; crowding was so tight they were "compacted within each other." Dreamer experimented with "different vibrations and sizes" and succeeded by vibrating at a higher pitch while intending to become smaller, allowing them to pull out of the compacted line.

Dreamer almost pulled a woman out of the compacted line; she tried to telepathically inform the dreamer that they were stuck like that so they could all go/travel somewhere. Dreamer replied they had more shopping to do and the group could go without them.

extraction.extraction_notes: Some elements are described as uncertain (e.g., whether there are walls vs limits; where the line is going). Time flow is not described, but sequence of events is clear (immobility → clarity → long line → vibration/size change → exit line → telepathic exchange).
